name: Superior Mastery
description: Extends this unit's reach by %cast_range_bonus% tiles, and every ability it casts cuts %cooldown_reduction% turn from each of its others.
details: No ability of its own may be cast more than once in the same turn, however quickly it comes back up.
Copied abilities are sharpened alongside the rest, and keep cooling down even while set aside.

upgrade.summary: The first %free_casts% ability each turn costs no action.
details: No ability of its own may be cast more than once in the same turn, however quickly it comes back up.
The first %free_casts% ability cast each turn spends no action, leaving the move and the attack untouched.
